internal.title: Incident Report: High Latency in Ad Service Due to CPU Resource Exhaustion
internal.body:
At 11:31 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for high latency in the ad service. Investigation identified that the service was experiencing CPU resource exhaustion, with CPU utilization reaching 98% of its limit. This was linked to a recent configuration flag change that increased CPU usage. Memory usage and error rates remained normal, ruling out memory leaks or errors as causes.

The mitigation involved disabling the recently enabled flag, which immediately reduced CPU usage and restored latency to normal levels by 11:51 UTC. The incident was resolved without further impact.

Key timeline:
- 11:31: Alert received for high latency
- 11:51: Diagnosis confirmed CPU resource exhaustion
- 11:51: Flag disabled
- 11:51: Latency returned to normal

This incident highlights the importance of monitoring resource usage impacts of configuration changes.

The issue was identified and resolved by adjusting a recent configuration change, restoring normal service performance. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.
